visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Function for Both Scalings
visualizerParams.problemDescription: double_all and triple_all are copies of each other except for one number. Replace them with one scale function that takes the factor. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Whatever differs between two copies of a function should become a parameter. One scale function replaces both, and a bug fixed in it is fixed everywhere.
